resume: Eight-track groovebox for sound design: thirteen synth engines, struck percussion and 33 drum machines after the Machinedrum, with an influence grid where each track can trigger, excite or modulate another.

commandes.role: Shifts the keyboard down one octave. On SEQ, changes step page; on pages with more settings than knobs, moves to the next row.
Shifts the keyboard up one octave. On SEQ, changes step page; on pages with more settings than knobs, moves to the next row.
Buses: delay, space, BED, feedback, master. Held + white keys 1 to 8: punch-ins (loop, reverse, stutter, freeze, low-pass, high-pass, throw, fill).
Scale section (called SCL in the docs): root, scale, transposition. Held, a key sets the root.
Articulation: start, hold and end of the note, FILTER ENV, step envelopes.
Modulation: matrix, two LFOs, dust, macros. Held + KNOB 1 to 4: macros 1 to 4.
The track's sound: engine, pitch, filter, mix, sends.
Song: mixers, scenes, arrangement, clock. Held + white keys 1 to 8 / 9 to 16: mute / solo; + black key 1: tap tempo.
The eight tracks at a glance and the influence grid.
Projects and sounds. Held + a white key: stores the scene 1 to 16.
The track's arpeggiator: mode, speed, octaves, hold.
Steps, tempo, graph. Held: the white keys become the steps, from any page.
Arms recording on the current track; then PLAY. Notes played and knobs turned are written into the steps.
Next page (right) or previous page (left) in the section.
Browses the page's list: sounds, patterns on SEQ, scenes on SONG, slots on SAVE.
Chooses track T1 to T8; the keys play that track.
Play the current track, or serve as steps, scenes or switches depending on the page and what is held.

gestes: A short press on a section button opens its page; holding it while using keys and knobs makes it a layer (SEQ held: steps; LFO held: macros; FX held: punch-ins), and releasing does not change the page.
Recording: touch REC, then PLAY; on the SEQ pages the keys then play notes, SEQ held turns them back into steps.
a_savoir: Every effect starts at zero: a new project sends nothing to the buses.
T8 can become the bus compressor (HOME, TRACKS, KIND = COMP).
